# Chinese Menu Decoder

> A traveler's Chinese menu decoder. Browse, translate and order real Chinese dishes with English names, Chinese characters, pinyin and price ranges.

## Main pages

- [Home - Chinese Menu Decoder](https://www.chinese-menus.com/): the full single-page decoder with dish explorer, city menus, cuisines, taste guide and FAQ.
- [About](https://www.chinese-menus.com/about/): who builds the site and how the dish data is sourced.
- [Contact](https://www.chinese-menus.com/contact/): reach the editorial team.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.chinese-menus.com/terms/): usage terms.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.chinese-menus.com/privacy-policy/): how visitor data is handled.

## Sections on the homepage

- [Menu map](https://www.chinese-menus.com/#anatomy): the six standard menu sections in order.
- [Dish explorer](https://www.chinese-menus.com/#explorer): 48 signature dishes with names, pinyin, prices and ordering tips.
- [City menus](https://www.chinese-menus.com/#city-menus): six cities and their signature menus, food streets and budgets.
- [The eight great cuisines](https://www.chinese-menus.com/#cuisines): regional schools with techniques and tips.
- [Taste guide](https://www.chinese-menus.com/#taste): six flavors and how to order them.
- [At the table](https://www.chinese-menus.com/#at-the-table): etiquette, phrases and key characters.
- [FAQ](https://www.chinese-menus.com/#faq): 28 traveler questions answered.

## Data

48 signature Chinese dishes with English name, Chinese name, pinyin, region, category, dietary tags, price range and description.

Six cities (Beijing, Shanghai, Chengdu, Xi'an, Guangzhou, Chongqing) with signature menus, food streets and daily budgets.

Eight great Chinese cuisines (Sichuan, Cantonese, Shandong, Jiangsu, Hunan, Zhejiang, Fujian, Anhui) with flavor profiles, techniques and ordering tips.
